_elevenlabs_note: Deferred to a later iteration as an owner-enabled feature. Nothing here selects it: backend must be set to 'elevenlabs' explicitly, and it then requires an API key from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or tts.elevenlabs.api_key in /etc/arlowe/config.yml. elevenlabs_voice_id and elevenlabs_model_id are intentionally absent -- they belong with the feature when it ships, not baked into the shipped default.
